intro: Kraylus is our next app: one calm, secure place to pay, get paid and manage your money, from everyday payments to digital assets. It's still on the drawing board, and we'll share more as it takes shape.

explore.title: Send & receive
explore.text: Pay friends, split costs and get paid in a couple of taps.

explore.title: One wallet
explore.text: Your balances and payments together, easy to read at a glance.

explore.title: Digital assets
explore.text: Buy, hold and keep track of crypto alongside your everyday money.

explore.title: Security first
explore.text: The same privacy-first standard as everything we build. Your money, your data.

note: Kraylus is in the concept stage and isn't available yet. Features and availability may change before launch.

roadmap.title: The idea
roadmap.text: Kraylus has a name, a direction and a very full notebook.

roadmap.title: Research & design
roadmap.text: Talking to people, sketching flows and testing the concept.

roadmap.title: Development
